messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that fall in Canada during 2023. These are the federal holidays that usually create at least a two‑day break (and often a three‑day weekend) across most of the country. (Some provinces observe extra holidays—see the “Provincial variations” section below.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Typical long‑weekend span |
|-------------|---------|---------------------------|
| **January 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | **Sat Dec 30 – Mon Jan 1** (2022–2023) |
| **February 20** (Mon) | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, MB, NB, PE) | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** |
| **April 7** (Fri) | Good Friday | **Fri Apr 7 – Sat Apr 8** |
| **May 22** (Mon) | Victoria Day | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** |
| **July 1** (Sat) | Canada Day | **Sat Jul 1 – Sun Jul 2** |
| **September 4** (Mon) | Labour Day | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** |
| **October 9** (Mon) | Thanksgiving | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** |
| **November 11** (Thu) | Remembrance Day | **Thu Nov 11 – Fri Nov 12** |
| **December 25** (Mon) | Christmas | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** |

### Provincial variations & extra long weekends

| Province/Territory | Extra holiday(s) in 2023 | Resulting long weekend(s) |
|--------------------|--------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Quebec** | Easter Monday (April 10) | **Fri Apr 7 – Mon Apr 10** |
| **Ontario** | Civic Holiday (August 14) | **Sat Aug 12 – Mon Aug 14** |
| **Alberta** | Heritage Day (Sept 15) | **Sat Sep 16 – Mon Sep 18** |
| **Manitoba** | St. John’s Day (June 5) | **Sat Jun 3 – Mon Jun 5** |
| **New Brunswick** | Saint Patrick’s Day (March 17) | **Sat Mar 18 – Mon Mar 20** |
| **Nova Scotia** | St. George’s Day (April 23) | **Sat Apr 21 – Mon Apr 23** |
| **Prince Edward Island** | St. George’s Day (April 23) | **Sat Apr 21 – Mon Apr 23** |
| **Saskatchewan** | Saskatchewan Day (June 23) | **Sat Jun 24 – Mon Jun 26** |
| **British Columbia** | BC Day (August 7) | **Sat Aug 5 – Mon Aug 7** |
| **Yukon** | Yukon Day (August 7) | **Sat Aug 5 – Mon Aug 7** |
| **Northwest Territories** | NWT Day (August 7) | **Sat Aug 5 – Mon Aug 7** |
| **Nunavut** | Nunavut Day (August 7) | **Sat Aug 5 – Mon Aug 7** |

> **Tip:** If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll want to merge the above table with the federal list. Some provinces also observe *statutory* holidays that aren’t nationwide (e.g., St. John’s Day in Manitoba, St. George’s Day in Nova Scotia/PEI, etc.).

Let me know if you’d like the full list broken down by each province/territory, or if there’s anything else you’d like to add!
